verdict.rationale: Kick documents role-based access control to scope who can see and do what in the workspace, an Activity tab providing a full audit trail of all changes (including AI actions), period locking that lets an accountant finalize and protect books after review, and the product is explicitly marketed to accountants/bookkeepers as their platform (kick.co/accountants), with a dedicated Tax Package export for handoff to preparers. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation showing a granular 'accountant' role definition or invite flow UI screenshot, and no independent/third-party corroboration of RBAC granularity in practice.
